es: Reconstruir el orden real de los hechos en una anécdota que salta entre tiempos (past simple, past perfect, past perfect continuous, would) y sus marcadores.

teaching.en: By the time the last train arrived, my grandmother had been waiting on the platform for two hours.
teaching.es: Cuando llegó el último tren, mi abuela llevaba dos horas esperando en el andén.
teaching.explanationEs: Past perfect continuous (had been waiting): una actividad en curso antes del hecho principal.
segments: By the time the last train arrived, my grandmother
had been waiting on the platform for two hours.
teaching.audioText: By the time the last train arrived, my grandmother had been waiting on the platform for two hours.

teaching.en: Years earlier, her father had promised to take her to the city.
teaching.es: Años antes, su padre le había prometido llevarla a la ciudad.
teaching.explanationEs: Past perfect (had promised): un hecho anterior al momento que se cuenta; years earlier lo señala.
segments: Years earlier, her father had promised
to take her to the city.
teaching.audioText: Years earlier, her father had promised to take her to the city.

teaching.en: Her cousin wasn't on the train, so she walked home alone.
teaching.es: Su primo no iba en el tren, así que volvió sola a casa.
teaching.explanationEs: Past simple: la línea principal de la historia, en orden.
segments: Her cousin wasn't on the train,
teaching.audioText: Her cousin wasn't on the train, so she walked home alone.

teaching.en: A stranger gave her his umbrella, and they talked until the rain stopped.
teaching.es: Un desconocido le dio su paraguas y hablaron hasta que dejó de llover.
teaching.explanationEs: Los hechos principales van en past simple: gave, talked, stopped.
segments: A stranger gave her his umbrella, and
they talked until the rain stopped.
teaching.audioText: A stranger gave her his umbrella, and they talked until the rain stopped.

teaching.en: She didn't know it then, but she would marry him three years later.
teaching.es: Entonces no lo sabía, pero se casaría con él tres años después.
teaching.explanationEs: Would + verbo: anticipa algo posterior al momento del relato, visto desde el pasado.
segments: She didn't know it then, but she
would marry him three years later.
teaching.audioText: She didn't know it then, but she would marry him three years later.

teaching.en: An hour earlier, the man at the station had told her the train was late.
teaching.es: Una hora antes, el hombre de la estación le había dicho que el tren llegaba tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: Had told: hecho anterior al momento principal; an hour earlier lo marca.
segments: An hour earlier, the man at the station
had told her the train was late.
teaching.audioText: An hour earlier, the man at the station had told her the train was late.

prompt.es: ¿Qué tiempo verbal marca lo que ya duraba antes de llegar el tren?

feedback.es: Had been waiting expresa una actividad que duraba hasta un momento pasado. Was waiting no tiene esa idea de duración previa y waited sería posterior.

hint.es: Es una actividad en curso con duración, anterior al hecho principal.

origin.text: When the train arrived, my grandmother ___ for two hours.

prompt.es: Completa: «Años antes, mi padre me había prometido llevarme a la ciudad.»

feedback.es: El hecho es anterior al momento que cuentas: past perfect, con had + participio.

hint.es: Es el auxiliar del past perfect.

origin.text: Years earlier, my father ___ promised to take me to the city.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Cuando llegó el tren, ella llevaba dos horas esperando.»

answer.text: When the train arrived, she had been waiting for two hours

feedback.es: La frase principal va en pasado simple (arrived) y el fondo anterior en had been waiting.

hint.es: Primero el hecho principal, luego el fondo con la duración.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ocurrió primero.

feedback.es: Had worked indica que fue anterior a abrir el restaurante: primero trabajó como cocinero, después abrió el restaurante en 1998.

origin.audio: My uncle had worked as a cook for ten years before he opened his own restaurant in 1998.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada forma con su lugar en la historia.

pairs.es: Actividad en curso hasta ese momento
Hecho posterior visto desde el pasado

feedback.es: Cada forma ocupa un lugar: past simple (línea principal), had promised (antes), had been studying (en curso hasta ese momento) y would marry (después).

pairs.es: Actividad en curso hasta ese momento
Hecho posterior visto desde el pasado

feedback.es: Had left indica que el último tren ya se había ido antes de que ella llegara. Llegar a la estación y volver a casa fueron después.

origin.text: She got to the station at six. The last train had left at half past five. She had to walk home.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es la cronología real de los hechos?

choices.text: The waiting, the promise, the umbrella, the wedding.
The wedding, the waiting, the umbrella, the promise.
The promise, the waiting, the umbrella, the wedding.

feedback.es: Primero, años antes, la promesa del padre; después, la espera en el andén; luego, el paraguas; y al final la boda, tres años después.

origin.text: My grandmother married the stranger three years after the night at the station. That night she had been waiting on the platform for two hours when it began to rain, and he gave her his umbrella. Years earlier, her father had promised to take her to the city.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ocurrió antes de que llegara el desconocido.

feedback.es: «Two weeks earlier, she had lost her job» es lo más antiguo. Después se sentó en el banco y, por último, llegó el desconocido.

origin.audio: By the time the stranger arrived, Mia had been sitting on the bench for an hour. Two weeks earlier, she had lost her job.

prompt.es: Completa: «Cuando encontré las llaves, la tienda ya había cerrado.»

feedback.es: La tienda cerró antes de encontrar las llaves: past perfect, had closed.

origin.text: By the time I found the keys, the shop ___ already closed.

prompt.es: Une los dos hechos en una sola frase: Sara esperó dos horas y luego llegó el autobús.

answer.text: When the bus arrived, Sara had been waiting for two hours.
accepted: When the bus arrived, Sara had been waiting for two hours.
By the time the bus arrived, Sara had been waiting for two hours.
Sara had been waiting for two hours when the bus arrived.

feedback.es: La frase destaca el hecho principal (arrived) y el fondo anterior con duración (had been waiting for two hours).

origin.text: Dos hechos: Sara esperó el autobús durante dos horas. Después llegó el autobús. Escribe una sola frase en inglés que diga que, cuando llegó el autobús, Sara llevaba dos horas esperando.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase mira hacia el futuro desde el pasado?

choices.text: She had never met him before.
The stranger gave her his umbrella.

feedback.es: Would marry anticipa un hecho posterior al momento contado. Had never met es anterior y gave es un hecho de la línea principal.

origin.text: The stranger gave her his umbrella. She had never met him before. She would marry him later.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ocurrió antes de aquella noche.

choices.text: She said goodbye to the stranger.
She had never left the town.

feedback.es: «Before it, she had never left the town» fija lo anterior: nunca había salido de la ciudad. El cambio de vida fue después de aquella noche.

origin.audio: Looking back, she always said that night had changed her life. Before it, she had never left the town.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Dos años antes, su tío había abierto un restaurante.»

answer.text: Two years earlier, her uncle had opened a restaurant

feedback.es: Earlier marca el momento anterior y had opened pone el hecho en past perfect.
